name: bat
summary: cat with syntax highlighting, line numbers and git markers. Themes are Sublime .tmTheme files; the built-in ansi and base16 themes follow the terminal palette.
configFormat: plain list of command-line arguments, one per line (config file) plus BAT_* env vars; themes as .tmTheme files

windows.notes: Default config path verified on Windows 11 (`bat --config-file` with BAT_CONFIG_PATH unset): %APPDATA%\bat\config. BAT_CONFIG_PATH / BAT_CONFIG_DIR override it (scoop's bat package may set BAT_CONFIG_DIR). Needs the VC++ redistributable and a less.exe for paging (otherwise use --paging=never).

install.notes: On older Debian/Ubuntu the executable is `batcat`; symlink: ln -s /usr/bin/batcat ~/.local/bin/bat.

theme.notes: Built-in ansi/base16 follow the terminal; custom palettes via a generated .tmTheme + `bat cache --build`.

integration.notes: fzf preview, MANPAGER, git, cat alias, delta.
